reconstructed_captions.15: A military helicopter comes into view, hovering over the ship's deck.
reconstructed_captions.16: A thick rope is deployed from the helicopter, dropping down to the deck.
reconstructed_captions.17: The first soldier begins to fast-rope down from the helicopter.
reconstructed_captions.18: The soldier slides rapidly down the rope towards the deck.
reconstructed_captions.19: A view from the deck shows the soldier descending against the sky.
reconstructed_captions.20: The soldier nears the deck, preparing to land on their feet.
reconstructed_captions.21: The soldier lands on the deck and immediately moves away from the rope.
reconstructed_captions.22: A second soldier begins their fast-rope descent from the helicopter.
reconstructed_captions.23: The second soldier quickly descends, following the first.
reconstructed_captions.24: The second soldier lands as the first takes up a security position.
reconstructed_captions.25: A third soldier starts their descent, continuing the rapid deployment.
reconstructed_captions.26: The soldiers on the deck form a perimeter around the landing zone.
reconstructed_captions.27: The third soldier lands, and a fourth follows down the rope.
reconstructed_captions.28: More soldiers land on the deck, assembling into a tactical team.
reconstructed_captions.29: The helicopter hovers as the final soldier of the group makes their descent.
